name: SYNDICATE RUN
intro: Read the runway, commit to the launch, then airbrake into the next beat.

design.focus: The expert finale chains boost, launch, airborne lane choice, landing reward, and precision recovery across one long escalating lap.
design.qualifierTargetBasis: A deterministic clean no-boost line runs about 65.6 seconds. Gold at 72 seconds preserves one small execution allowance, Silver at 80 allows a correction, and the 88-second qualifying deadline leaves about twenty-two seconds without making the finale a free clear.
design.rivalLapRationale: Three laps answer playtest feedback that the Rival Race ended before route optimization or combat could develop: lap one reads the line, lap two attacks it, and lap three settles the race.

cycles.summary: A broad opening runway teaches the finale's left-to-right airbrake transfer before a gentle climb.
cycles.flow: read -> bank boost -> straight launch -> airborne transfer -> landing speed line -> single-lane rock read -> breathe
cycles.safeLine: Hold the center/right lanes, take the ramp at cruise speed, and pass the visible left-edge rocks on pavement.
cycles.committedLine: Spend boost on the ramp, move across the road in the air, and catch the landing speed line without lifting.

cycles.summary: A faster rock-clear jump lands into a cone transfer and releases onto clean road.
cycles.flow: read -> boost pickup -> rock-clear launch -> airbrake lane choice -> cone sweep -> right-edge debris -> breathe
cycles.safeLine: Skip the optional launch and use either open ground lane beside the ramp lane's rocks.
cycles.committedLine: Boost over the ramp-lane rocks, land off-axis, and carry the cone line through the bend.

cycles.summary: Dirt lowers the pulse, then a clean jump and speed line feed the first sharp chicane.
cycles.flow: dirt read -> bank boost -> launch -> controlled glide -> zipper payoff -> chicane and open rock lane -> breathe
cycles.safeLine: Exit the dirt early, take the ramp neutrally, then use the two clear lanes through the chicane.
cycles.committedLine: Protect momentum on dirt, boost the launch, catch the landing speed line, and airbrake into the chicane.

cycles.summary: A climb and sweeping bend reveal a rock-clear launch whose landing demands a quick return line.
cycles.flow: climb read -> reserve boost -> curved approach -> rock-clear launch -> center debris precision -> return-line cones -> breathe
cycles.safeLine: Climb without spending boost and stay in either ground lane not occupied by the ramp payload.
cycles.committedLine: Carry stored boost through the bend, launch over the rocks, and snap back across the cone line after the debris beat.

cycles.summary: The climax turns a loose dirt launch into the longest cone smash before the tightest early chicane.
cycles.flow: dirt read -> boost commit -> launch -> long airbrake transfer -> landing speed line -> sharp chicane -> breathe
cycles.safeLine: Settle on the dirt, jump at normal speed, and use the full recovery straight for a cleaner chicane entry.
cycles.committedLine: Boost off the dirt ramp, cross the road in flight, catch the landing speed line, then airbrake into the chicane.

cycles.summary: The arrangement breathes on a broad climb: one clean launch, one sweeping bend, and generous recovery.
cycles.flow: long read -> bank boost -> hill launch -> measured glide -> clean landing -> one-lane debris read -> long breathe
cycles.safeLine: Save boost, crest at cruise speed, and use the broad open road around the isolated left-lane rocks.
cycles.committedLine: Spend boost at the crest and use an airborne lane change to preserve speed through the downhill sweeper.

cycles.summary: Curve and dirt rebuild tension before a late rock-clear launch drops directly into an expert chicane.
cycles.flow: surface read -> reserve boost -> late launch -> air choice -> landing speed line -> chicane -> recovery straight -> breathe
cycles.safeLine: Take the dirt and launch conservatively, then use the open ground lanes and settle before the chicane.
cycles.committedLine: Carry boost through the surface change, clear the ramp rocks, catch the landing reward, and thread the chicane without lifting.

cycles.summary: The final rebuild combines the steepest descent, a rock-clear jump, a sharp return curve, and a five-cone finish sweep.
cycles.flow: vista read -> backup boost -> rock-clear launch -> hard airbrake transfer -> visible rock lane -> five-cone payoff -> finish recovery
cycles.safeLine: Use the full straight to read the ramp lane, stay grounded in either open lane, then avoid the optional cones on the final curve.
cycles.committedLine: Stack boost, launch over the rocks, airbrake to the clear landing, then cross back for all five cones before the finish straight.
